name: Equalizer
description: A wall of graphic equalizer meters, each a column of square segments lit green, then amber, then red to a level that rises and falls across the spectrum.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --n: @calc(@rn(-1, 14, 1.5) + @r(-1.2, 1.2)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 19%; right: 19%; top: 4%; bottom: 8%; background: @p(var(--color4)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 1.8%, #000 1.8% 10.7%, transparent 10.7% 12.5%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 1.8%, #000 1.8% 10.7%, transparent 10.7% 12.5%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 19%; right: 19%; top: 4%; bottom: 8%; background: linear-gradient(0deg, var(--color1) 0 50%, var(--color2) 50% 75%, var(--color3) 75%); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 1.8%, #000 1.8% 10.7%, transparent 10.7% 12.5%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 1.8%, #000 1.8% 10.7%, transparent 10.7% 12.5%); -webkit-clip-path: inset($(12.5 * (8 - max(1, min(8, round(n)))))% 0% 0% 0%); clip-path: inset($(12.5 * (8 - max(1, min(8, round(n)))))% 0% 0% 0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
